changelog:
- Initial release of the auto-updater skill.
- Automatically checks for and installs updates to Clawdbot and all installed skills once daily via cron.
- Sends a summary message to the user detailing what was updated and any issues encountered.
- Provides options for setup, configuration, troubleshooting, and disabling auto-updates.
